Write a complete C program (C11) that solves the following problem. Reply with the code only.

Read two integers on a single line separated by whitespace and print their sum followed by a newline.

Each integer fits in a signed 32-bit int (-2147483648 .. 2147483647). The sum may not.

Sample input:
7 5

Sample output:
12
